title: Completion of a coordinate restriction
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, assign each coordinate one of the statuses free, fixed to $1$, or fixed to $-1$, and let $x\\in\\mathbb F_2^n$. The completed sign vector has, at each free coordinate, the sign encoding of the corresponding bit of $x$; at coordinates fixed to $1$ or $-1$, it has that prescribed sign.
hypotheses_covered: a restriction status is assigned to every coordinate
$x$ is an element of the binary cube $\\mathbb F_2^n$
